_comment: Pilot lane: single till, Tamil receipts. Copy this to %LOCALAPPDATA%\RetailPOS\settings.json, fill in every FILL IN, and delete these two comment lines. Save as UTF-8 - see SETTINGS.html.
_identity: Take the GSTIN and FSSAI number from the shop's own certificates, not from an old printed bill. One wrong character prints on every invoice the shop issues and nothing can catch it.

store.name: FILL IN - the shop name, in Tamil
store.gstin: FILL IN - from the GST certificate
store.fssaiNumber: FILL IN - from the FSSAI licence

hardware.printerName: CHANGE ME - exact Windows printer name
